Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: The Symbol Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the specified symbol.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Side Indicator

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Set to 'Y'

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: The long version of the Add Order message accommodates larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Side Indicator

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Set to 'Y'

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified, MPID or 'RTAL' for retail specified orders (equities) of firm attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: CustomerIndicator
Field.Description: (EDGX Only), space filled on other Cboe Equities Exchanges.

Message.Name: Add Order Extended Message
Message.Description: The extended version of the Add Order message accommodates larger prices.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Side Indicator

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Y = The order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote.

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified, MPID or 'RTAL' for retail specified orders (equities) of firm attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: CustomerIndicator
Field.Description: (EDGX Only), space filled on other Cboe Equities Exchanges.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: Order Cancel messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is canceled in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced or canceled

Field.Name: Canceled Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares canceled

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders or shares on the Cboe book and routed orders.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order ID of the executed order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of side of resting order

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Incremental Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cboe is broken.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution ID refers to previously sent Order Execution or Trade message.

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Auction Update messages are used to disseminate Cboe price and size information during auctions for Cboe listed securities on BZX, and for Periodic Auctions on BYX.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: BBO Collared auction price.

Field.Name: Buy Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on buy side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Sell Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on sell side at the Reference Price. Shares matched for Cboe Market Close.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book and the continuous book would match.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book would match using only Eligible Auction Orders.

Message.Description: The extended version of the BZX Auction Update message accommodates larger prices.
